{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output_head": "# Chat Bots Architecture

## Data Model
- Bots are stored as `User` records with `role: :bot` (enum values: `member: 0, administrator: 1, bot: 2`).
- `users.bot_token` stores a 24-character `SecureRandom.base58` credential (unique indexed, filtered from logs and `inspect` via `:token` in `filter_parameters`).
- `users.creator_id` references the `User` who created the bot, enabling `User#can_administer?(bot)` for creators and administrators.
- Reusing `User` gives bots room `Membership`s, automatic open room joining (`after_create_commit :grant_membership_to_open_rooms`), `Message` authorship (`creator_id`), `ActiveStorage` avatars, `@mention` support, and `Rooms::Closed` membership management out of the box.
- Deleting a bot calls `User#deactivate`, which sets `status: :deactivated`, clears `bot_token: nil`, and removes non-direct memberships while preserving previously posted messages.
- Human-only flows (`SessionsController`, `Sessions::TransfersController`, `AccountsController`, `Accounts::UsersController`, `Users::SidebarsController`) scope with `User.without_bots`.

## UI Routes & Access Control
- `/account/edit` exposes the "Set up chat bots" link (`/bots`) to all signed-in members.
- `BotsController` (`/bots`, `/bots/new`, `/bots/:id/edit`) lists `Current.user.created_bots.active` for members and all `User.bots` for administrators on a single unpaginated page.
- `edit`, `update`, and `destroy` require `Current.user.can_administer?(@bot)` (creator or administrator).

## HTTP Message API
- `POST /rooms/:room_id/:bot_token/messages` (`Bots::MessagesController#create`) authenticates via `User.find_by_bot_token` and scopes the room to `@bot.rooms`.
- For non-multipart requests, `Bots::MessagesController#process_action` sets `request.request_parameters = {}` before `super` so Rails/Rack never attempts to form-parse or JSON-parse raw text bodies (e.g. `curl -d "100% done"`).
- Raw bodies are UTF-8 normalized, HTML-escaped, and newline-converted before saving as ActionText `Message` bodies; `multipart/form-data` requests with `attachment` use `create_with_attachment!`.
- Responses: `201 Created` (`Location: /messages/:message_id`), `422 Unprocessable Content`, `404 Not Found`, `401 Unauthorized`.

Rails.application.routes.draw do
  root "welcome#show"

  resource :first_run

  resource :session do
    scope module: "sessions" do
      resources :transfers, only: %i[ show update ]
    end
  end

  resource :account do
    scope module: "accounts" do
      resources :users

      resource :join_code, only: :create
      resource :logo, only: %i[ show destroy ]
      resource :custom_styles, only: %i[ edit update ]
    end
  end

  direct :fresh_account_logo do |options|
    route_for :account_logo, v: Current.account&.updated_at&.to_fs(:number), size: options[:size]
  end

  get "join/:join_code", to: "users#new", as: :join
  post "join/:join_code", to: "users#create"

  resources :qr_code, only: :show

  resources :bots

  resources :users, only: :show do
    scope module: "users" do
      resource :avatar, only: %i[ show destroy ]
      resource :ban, only: %i[ create destroy ]

      scope defaults: { user_id: "me" } do
        resource :sidebar, only: :show
        resource :profile
        resources :push_subscriptions do
          scope module: "push_subscriptions" do
            resources :test_notifications, only: :create
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  namespace :autocompletable do
    resources :users, only: :index
  end

  direct :fresh_user_avatar do |user, options|
    route_for :user_avatar, user.avatar_token, v: user.updated_at.to_fs(:number)
  end

  resources :rooms do
    resources :messages

    scope module: "rooms" do
      resource :refresh, only: :show
      resource :settings, only: :show
      resource :involvement, only: %i[ show update ]
    end

    get "@:message_id", to: "rooms#show", as: :at_message
    post ":bot_token/messages", to: "bots/messages#create", as: :bot_messages
  end

  namespace :rooms do
    resources :opens
    resources :closeds
    resources :directs
  end

  resources :messages do
    scope module: "messages" do
      resources :boosts
    end
  end

  resources :searches, only: %i[ index create ] do
    delete :clear, on: :collection

class Room::MessagePusher
  attr_reader :room, :message

  def initialize(room:, message:)
    @room, @message = room, message
  end

  def push
    build_payload.tap do |payload|
      push_to_users_involved_in_everything(payload)
      push_to_users_involved_in_mentions(payload)
    end
  end

  private
    def build_payload
      if room.direct?
        build_direct_payload
      else
        build_shared_payload
      end
    end

    def build_direct_payload
      {
        title: message.creator.name,
        body: message.plain_text_body,
        path: Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.room_path(room)
      }
    end

    def build_shared_payload
      {
        title: room.name,
        body: "#{message.creator.name}: #{message.plain_text_body}",
        path: Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.room_path(room)
      }
    end

    def push_to_users_involved_in_everything(payload)
      enqueue_payload_for_delivery payload, push_subscriptions_for_users_involved_in_everything
    end

    def push_to_users_involved_in_mentions(payload)
      enqueue_payload_for_delivery payload, push_subscriptions_for_mentionable_users(message.mentionees)
    end

    def push_subscriptions_for_users_involved_in_everything
      relevant_subscriptions.merge(Membership.involved_in_everything)
    end

    def push_subscriptions_for_mentionable_users(mentionees)
      relevant_subscriptions.merge(Membership.involved_in_mentions).where(user_id: mentionees.ids)
    end

    def relevant_subscriptions
      Push::Subscription
        .joins(user: :memberships)
        .merge(Membership.visible.disconnected.where(room: room).where.not(user: message.creator))
    end

    def enqueue_payload_for_delivery(payload, subscriptions)
      Rails.configuration.x.web_push_pool.queue(payload, subscriptions)
    end
end

require "test_helper"

class User::BotTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "creating a bot generates a bot_token and grants membership to open rooms" do
    bot = nil

    assert_difference -> { Membership.count }, +Rooms::Open.count do
      bot = User.create!(name: "Deploy Bot", role: :bot, creator: users(:kevin))
    end

    assert bot.bot?
    assert bot.active?
    assert bot.bot_code.present?
    assert_equal bot.bot_token, bot.bot_code
    assert_equal users(:kevin), bot.creator
    Rooms::Open.find_each do |room|
      assert_includes room.users, bot
    end
  end

  test "bots require a name" do
    bot = User.new(name: "", role: :bot, creator: users(:kevin))
    assert_not bot.valid?
    assert_includes bot.errors[:name], "can't be blank"
  end

  test "find_by_bot_token finds active bots only and rejects blank tokens" do
    bot = User.create!(name: "Deploy Bot", role: :bot, creator: users(:kevin))
    token = bot.bot_code

    assert_equal bot, User.find_by_bot_token(token)
    assert_nil User.find_by_bot_token("")
    assert_nil User.find_by_bot_token(nil)
    assert_nil User.find_by_bot_token("nonexistent")

    bot.deactivate
    assert_nil User.find_by_bot_token(token)
    assert_nil bot.reload.bot_code
  end

  test "deactivating a bot preserves its messages and removes non-direct memberships" do
    bot = User.create!(name: "Deploy Bot", role: :bot, creator: users(:kevin))
    message = rooms(:watercooler).messages.create!(creator: bot, body: "Deployed v1.0")

    assert_difference -> { Membership.count }, -Rooms::Open.count do
      bot.deactivate
    end

    assert bot.reload.deactivated?
    assert Message.exists?(message.id)
    assert_equal "Deploy Bot", message.reload.creator.name
  end

  test "can_administer? allows creator and administrators for bots, and bots cannot administer anything" do
    bot = User.create!(name: "Deploy Bot", role: :bot, creator: users(:kevin))

    assert users(:kevin).can_administer?(bot)
    assert users(:david).can_administer?(bot)
    assert_not ",
  "output_tail": ".creator
    assert_equal "Deploy of v1.2.3 finished ✅", message.plain_text_body
  end

  test "raw body preserves special characters, ampersands, angle brackets, and newlines safely" do
    raw = "Build 100% ok: a=1 & b=2\nExpected <int> got <nil>\nhttps://example.com"

    post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code),
      params: raw,
      headers: { "CONTENT_TYPE" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" }

    assert_response :created
    message = @room.messages.ordered.last
    assert_equal raw, message.plain_text_body
  end

  test "raw body works even when Content-Type is application/json with non-JSON text" do
    post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code),
      params: "Plain text despite json content type",
      headers: { "CONTENT_TYPE" => "application/json" }

    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "Plain text despite json content type", @room.messages.ordered.last.plain_text_body
  end

  test "posting an attachment creates an attachment message and returns 201 with Location" do
    assert_difference -> { @room.messages.count }, 1 do
      post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code),
        params: { attachment: fixture_file_upload("moon.jpg", "image/jpeg") }
    end

    message = @room.messages.ordered.last
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "/messages/#{message.id}", response.headers["Location"]
    assert message.attachment.attached?
    assert_equal @bot, message.creator
  end

  test "empty body and no attachment returns 422 Unprocessable Content" do
    assert_no_difference -> { Message.count } do
      post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code), params: ""
    end
    assert_response :unprocessable_content

    assert_no_difference -> { Message.count } do
      post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code), params: "   \n  "
    end
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
  end

  test "bad room id returns 404 Not Found" do
    assert_no_difference -> { Message.count } do
      post room_bot_messages_url(999_999, @bot.bot_code), params: "Hello"
    end

    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "closed room without bot membership returns 404 until bot is added" do
    closed_room = rooms(:designers)
    assert_not_includes closed_room.users, @bot

    post room_bot_messages_url(closed_room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Hello closed room"
    assert_response :not_found

    closed_room.memberships.grant_to(@bot)
    post room_bot_messages_url(closed_room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Hello closed room"
    assert_response :created
  end

  test "invalid bot code returns 401 Unauthorized" do
    assert_no_difference -> { Message.count } do
      post room_bot_messages_url(@room, "invalid-bot-code"), params: "Hello"
    end

    assert_response :unauthorized
  end

  test "deleted bot can no longer post messages and returns 401 Unauthorized" do
    code = @bot.bot_code
    @bot.deactivate

    assert_no_difference -> { Message.count } do
      post room_bot_messages_url(@room, code), params: "Hello from beyond"
    end

    assert_response :unauthorized
  end

  test "creating a bot message broadcasts to room with bot name and unread to room members" do
    post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Deploy finished"

    assert_rendered_turbo_stream_broadcast @room, :messages, action: "append", target: [ @room, :messages ] do
      assert_select ".message__author", text: /Deploy Bot/
      assert_select ".message__body", text: /Deploy finished/
    end

    @room.users.each do |member|
      assert_broadcasts UnreadRoomsChannel.stream_name_for(member.id), 1 do
        post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Ping #{member.id}"
      end
    end

    closed_room = rooms(:designers)
    closed_room.memberships.grant_to(@bot)
    outsiders = User.where.not(id: closed_room.users.map(&:id))
    assert outsiders.any?
    outsiders.each do |outsider|
      assert_no_broadcasts UnreadRoomsChannel.stream_name_for(outsider.id) do
        post room_bot_messages_url(closed_room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Closed room ping"
      end
    end
  end

  test "creating a bot message enqueues and triggers push notifications" do
    closed_room = rooms(:designers)
    closed_room.memberships.grant_to(@bot)

    assert_enqueued_jobs 1, only: [ Room::PushMessageJob ] do
      post room_bot_messages_url(closed_room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Alert!"
    end

    perform_enqueued_jobs only: Room::PushMessageJob do
      WebPush.expects(:payload_send).times(2)
      post room_bot_messages_url(closed_room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Alert again!"
    end
  end

test "bot message renders in the room with the bot name as author" do
  post room_bot_messages_url(@room, @bot.bot_code), params: "Deploy of v1.2.3 finished ✅"
  assert_response :created

  sign_in :kevin
  get room_url(@room)
  assert_response :success
  assert_select ".message__author", text: /Deploy Bot/
  assert_select ".message__body", text: /Deploy of v1.2.3 finished ✅/
end
end

module RestrictedHTTP
  class Violation < StandardError; end

  # The address policy lives in the surfguard gem so this app, Basecamp, HEY and
  # Fizzy classify "internal" the same way instead of each keeping a copy that
  # drifts. The callers here hand a bare hostname in and pin the address that
  # comes back, so this stays a hostname-in, address-out shim.
  module PrivateNetworkGuard
    extend self

    # A hostname that resolves to nothing (NXDOMAIN, timeout, empty answer)
    # raises Surfguard::Unresolvable, which we let propagate as a lookup failure
    # -- the same way the old Resolv.getaddress guard raised Resolv::ResolvError,
    # and the callers here already treat it as a fetch failure. The Violation is
    # reserved for a host that resolves to a blocked address (an empty list back
    # from resolve_public_ips), so a transient DNS miss is never misreported as
    # an SSRF attempt.
    def resolve(hostname)
      Surfguard.resolve_public_ips(hostname).first or
        raise Violation.new("Attempt to access private IP via #{hostname}")
    end

    def private_ip?(ip)
      Surfguard.blocked_address?(ip)
    end
  end
end

require "net/http"
require "restricted_http/private_network_guard"

class Opengraph::Fetch
  ALLOWED_DOCUMENT_CONTENT_TYPE = "text/html"
  MAX_BODY_SIZE = 5.megabytes
  MAX_REDIRECTS = 10

  class TooManyRedirectsError < StandardError; end
  class RedirectDeniedError < StandardError; end

  def fetch_document(url, ip: RestrictedHTTP::PrivateNetworkGuard.resolve(url.host))
    request(url, Net::HTTP::Get, ip: ip) do |response|
      return body_if_acceptable(response)
    end
  end

  def fetch_content_type(url, ip: RestrictedHTTP::PrivateNetworkGuard.resolve(url.host))
    request(url, Net::HTTP::Head, ip: ip) do |response|
      return response["Content-Type"]
    end
  end

  private
    def request(url, request_class, ip:)
      MAX_REDIRECTS.times do
        Net::HTTP.start(url.host, url.port, ipaddr: ip, use_ssl: url.scheme == "https") do |http|
          http.request request_class.new(url) do |response|
            if response.is_a?(Net::HTTPRedirection)
              url, ip = resolve_redirect(response["location"])
            else
              yield response
            end
          end
        end
      end

      raise TooManyRedirectsError
    end

    def resolve_redirect(location)
      url = URI.parse(location)
      raise RedirectDeniedError unless url.is_a?(URI::HTTP)
      [ url, RestrictedHTTP::PrivateNetworkGuard.resolve(url.host) ]
    end

    def body_if_acceptable(response)
      size_restricted_body(response) if response_valid?(response)
    end

    def size_restricted_body(response)
      # We've already checked the Content-Length header, to try to avoid reading
      # the body of any large responses. But that header could be wrong or
      # missing. To be on the safe side, we'll read the body in chunks, and bail
      # if it runs over our size limit.
      StringIO.new.tap do |body|
        response.read_body do |chunk|
          return nil if body.string.bytesize + chunk.bytesize > MAX_BODY_SIZE
          body << chunk
        end
      end.string
    end

    def response_valid?(response)
      status_valid?(response) && content_type_valid?(response) && content_length_valid?(response)
    end

    def status_valid?(response)
      response.is_a?(Net::HTTPOK)
    end

    def content_type_valid?(response)
      response.content_type == ALLOWED_DOCUMENT_CONTENT_TYPE
    end

    def content_length_valid?(response)
      response.content_length.to_i <= MAX_BODY_SIZE
    end
end

    redirect_to room_url(room)
  end

  def edit

  end

  def update
    @room.update! room_params

    broadcast_update_room
    redirect_to room_url(@room)
  end

    end

    def room_scope
